name: Net-points rating + empirical HFA
rule: Bet the side whose walk-forward shrunk net-points rating plus the empirical HFA implies a margin differing from the originator's own fair spread by more than the gate threshold.

name: Depth-adjusted injury fade
rule: Fade any team whose confirmed Out/IR model prior exceeds the opponent's by the gate threshold, using the active backup string to size the prior.
not_evaluable_reason: No official historical input exists to grade this rule: the official injury/depth register was only published for Week 10 (FLG-03), and no official player-prop line exists (FLG-01, FLG-02).

name: Offensive-line continuity fade
rule: Fade teams with 2+ offensive-line 1st-string players Out/IR/DNP.
not_evaluable_reason: No official historical input exists to grade this rule: the official injury/depth register was only published for Week 10 (FLG-03), and no official player-prop line exists (FLG-01, FLG-02).

name: Rest-differential play
rule: Back the team with the rest-days advantage when the differential meets the gate threshold.

name: Divisional-underdog contrarian
rule: Back divisional underdogs, where favourite bias is documented and games are historically tighter.
fire_rule: divisional game; back the lower net-rating side

name: Totals: depth-driven scoring-environment
rule: Play the total when the combined offensive rating delta and the defensive depletion prior move the originator's total past the gate threshold.
not_evaluable_reason: No official historical input exists to grade this rule: the official injury/depth register was only published for Week 10 (FLG-03), and no official player-prop line exists (FLG-01, FLG-02).

name: Two-leg low-correlation parlay
rule: Pair two single-bet signals whose measured Pearson r is below the correlation cap, else reject the parlay.

name: Same-game QB + target prop combo
rule: Combine a QB passing-yards over with his primary target's receiving-yards over only when the measured same-game r is positive and the joint probability clears the gate.
status: measured (no official lines to bet; FLG-01)
not_evaluable_reason: No official historical input exists to grade this rule: the official injury/depth register was only published for Week 10 (FLG-03), and no official player-prop line exists (FLG-01, FLG-02).

name: Negative-correlation hedge combo
rule: Combine a QB passing-yards over with the lead RB's rushing-yards over when the measured r is negative, using the Frechet lower bound for the joint probability.
status: measured (no official lines to bet; FLG-01)
not_evaluable_reason: No official historical input exists to grade this rule: the official injury/depth register was only published for Week 10 (FLG-03), and no official player-prop line exists (FLG-01, FLG-02).

name: Composite gated ensemble
rule: Take only the bets on which every individually gated single-bet strategy agrees, i.e. the intersection of STR-01, STR-02 and STR-04.
